findings.highlight: I haven’t put any thought into them
findings.evidenceJa: そのどれを取るべきかはまだ考えていなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes several means exist but has not considered which one to choose.
findings.explanation: The English falsely says he has given none of the possibilities any thought.

findings.governingReading: Shirou must warn Illya about Zouken’s covert machinations and the unidentified shadow or something irreparable may happen.
findings.explanation: The English deletes Zouken’s covert action and specifies the uncertain irreversible outcome as fatal to Illya.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺より何倍も危険だろう
findings.governingReading: Sakura is probably many times more endangered than Shirou because she cannot resist Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English drops the magnitude of his protective calculation.

findings.evidenceJa: あり得ない名前を口にしかける
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins to utter a name whose presence here is impossible.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the name’s impossibility into an explicit psychological wish.

findings.highlight: It’s not that I’m putting undue importance on it
findings.evidenceJa: もったいぶってるんじゃなくて
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he is not being coy or theatrically withholding the reason.
findings.explanation: The English changes manner of disclosure into an assessment of importance.

findings.highlight: I shall answer it to the best of my ability
findings.evidenceJa: 私にできる範囲でなら聞き届けます
findings.governingReading: Rider agrees to grant or heed the request if it lies within her ability.
findings.explanation: The English changes compliance with a request into answering it.

findings.governingReading: Shirou jokes that Rider’s attempted pronunciation yields 死蝋, “corpse wax,” amid written homophone variants.
findings.explanation: The English erases the joke’s lexical mechanism and all distinct attempted forms.
